steps.request: Ask the key clarification questions before designing the architecture.
steps.answer: Before designing the architecture, I recommend six key clarification questions. Scale and availability: what are peak throughput, latency, SLA, RTO, and RPO targets? Security and compliance: which identities, data classifications, residency rules, and private-network requirements apply? Operations: what budget, deployment model, and on-call capability are available? These answers determine service tier, regional topology, isolation controls, and operational complexity; absent answers I will assume a 99.9% SLA, paired-region recovery, managed identity, private endpoints, and a moderate operations team.
